title: Flamingo eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water/ground hint -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#1a3a4a'/>

  <!-- flamingo body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#ff7eb3'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='58' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#ff9ec8'/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='60' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ff5c9e'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='58' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ff8dbf'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M68 62 Q78 56 76 68 Q72 66 68 68 Z' fill='#ff5c9e'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q30 40 32 28 Q34 18 44 16' stroke='#ff7eb3' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 52 Q30 40 32 28 Q34 18 44 16' stroke='#ffa8d0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='16' r='9' fill='#ff7eb3'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='16' r='6' fill='#ffa8d0'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='13' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='49.8' cy='12.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M54 16 L64 19 L54 22 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <path d='M54 19 L62 19 L54 22 Z' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='19.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffddaa'/>

  <!-- snack: a little shrimp/candy in beak area -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='20' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff6b6b' transform='rotate(-20 66 20)'/>
  <path d='M63 18 Q60 15 62 13' stroke='#ff4d4d' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='19' r='0.8' fill='#ffe0e0'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='44' y1='76' x2='42' y2='90' stroke='#ff5c9e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='76' x2='56' y2='90' stroke='#ff5c9e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M38 90 L42 90 L44 93' stroke='#ff9ec8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 90 L56 90 L58 93' stroke='#ff9ec8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
